name: krate-mac-gate
description: Playwright pinned to the gate image version (scripts/gate-identity.sh:889), driving the installed Google Chrome on the Mac. Install once on the connected Mac: PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=1 npm ci --prefix <this directory>, then point PW_MODULES at <this directory>/node_modules (harness/mac-browser already holds the same pin and is the live source this pin mirrors).
